name: Paul Atreides

You may look at the top card of your deck at any time.
[Action [Arrow]:] Discard the top card of your deck. Then, attack with a unit. If it has the same cost as the discarded card, it gets [+2/+0] for this attack.

[Raid 1]
[On Attack:] Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Discard 1 of them and put the others back in any order. If the discarded card has an [On Attack] ability, use it as if it were this unit's.
